## Slider.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The value, or a `[low, high]` pair for a range. Two-way bindable.
- `min` :: The smallest value.
- `max` :: The largest value.
- `step` :: The increment values snap to, for pointer and keyboard alike.
- `orientation` :: Lays the track out left to right (`horizontal`) or bottom to top (`vertical`).
- `marks` :: Draws ticks: `true` for one per step, or a list of positions with optional labels.
- `showValue` :: Shows the current value in a bubble above the thumb on hover, focus and drag.
- `format` :: Formats the value for the bubble and for assistive technology.
- `size` :: The track thickness, thumb size and text scale.
- `textSize` :: The text scale, independent of the track. Follows `size` when omitted.
- `label` :: Accessible name of the slider; a range appends "minimum" and "maximum".
- `disabled` :: Blocks pointer and keyboard input.
- `name` :: The field name; a hidden input per thumb submits the value with a form.
- `onValueChange` :: Called whenever the value changes, with the new value.
- `shape` :: The corner shape of the value bubble. @default 'modern'
- `surface` :: The recipe behind the value bubble: fill, border and shadow together. @default 'overlayed'
- `childTextSize` :: The scale of the tick labels and of the value bubble. @default 'text-xs'
- `childTextColor` :: The ink of the tick labels. @default 'text-muted'
